information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDSpring2023#26385-new-competitors). It will take place in West Ballroom B (second floor) of [UC San Diego's Price Center](https://universitycenters.ucsd.edu/_images/visit-us-images/PC_Directories11X17FA21_FNL1.pdf). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzB5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c648f1c37642837bd6ec7ced2a03e220352f5fbb/wcc-banner.png)
